The '''Rescue Recruiter''' is an '''NPC''' that appears outside either in {{zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} or {{zone|Chief's Hut}}, depending on the player's [[Faction]], after accepting a Rescue Mission. The player must then talk to the [[Undercover Agent]] to begin the quest.
